title: Diagonal extraction of one subsequence converging uniformly on countably many sets, with a single glued limit
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm. Let F_k : R^n -> L (k in N) be any maps and S_m (m in N) any subsets of R^n. Assume that for every m in N and every strictly increasing psi : N -> N there are a strictly increasing chi : N -> N and g : R^n -> L such that F_{psi(chi(j))} -> g uniformly on S_m as j -> infinity. Then there are a strictly increasing phi : N -> N and a single V : R^n -> L such that, for every m in N, F_{phi(j)} -> V uniformly on S_m as j -> infinity.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (S : ℕ → Set (Rn n)), (∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono ψ → ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono χ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F (ψ (χ j))) g atTop (S m)) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F (φ j)) V atTop (S m)
